Country: South Africa
Partner: Airalo e-SIM
Category: Data and Phone Plans
Overview: Airalo is the world’s first and largest eSIM marketplace, providing digital SIM (eSIM)
plans for travelers to access mobile data, and sometimes calls and texts, in over 200
countries and regions without needing a physical SIM card. To use Airalo, you download
the app, purchase a digital eSIM for your destination, install it on your compatible
device, and then connect to a mobile network upon arrival to get online.
Why we recommend: We recommend Airalo for its affordability, reliability, and convenience—offering seamless data access wherever you go.
How it helps: Airalo makes migration and travel easier by giving you instant, hassle-free mobile connectivity the moment you arrive in your new country.
Link: https://airalo.pxf.io/7m4YGA

Country: South Africa
Partner: Covermore
Category: Insurance
Overview: Covermore (or Cover-More) is a global travel insurance provider that offers protection
for travelers from unforeseen costs like medical emergencies, lost luggage, and trip
cancellations. It functions by offering various insurance plans that cover a range of
travel-related incidents, providing a financial safety net and access to 24/7 emergency
travel assistance services. The process involves purchasing a plan, and if a covered
event occurs, contacting the assistance center for help and then submitting a claim for
reimbursement or payment of expenses.
Why we recommend: Covermore is a trusted travel insurance provider with a strong reputation for reliability and comprehensive coverage.
How it helps: Their insurance gives you peace of mind by protecting you against unexpected costs such as medical emergencies, trip cancellations, or lost belongings.
Link: https://fxo.co/1313391/covermore

Country: South Africa
Partner: Expat Ride
Category: Vehicle Services
Overview: ExpatRide provides specialized global car services, such as rentals and leases, for
expatriates moving to new countries, offering a streamlined experience by handling the
complexities of local credit, licensing, and billing for their corporate clients and
Relocation Management Companies (RMCs). They offer personalized solutions,
including professional chauffeur services and airport transfers, to support expatriates'
transportation needs worldwide, functioning as a global mobility partner.
Why we recommend: Expat Ride specializes in helping expats with reliable, tailored car solutions worldwide.
How it helps: They make your relocation easier by providing car rentals, leases, and chauffeur services that fit your needs in a new country.
Link: https://www.expatride.com/smooth-migration/

Country: South Africa
Partner: Rentcars.com
Category: Vehicle Services
Overview: Rentcars.com is a global online platform for renting cars that compares prices and
options from hundreds of car rental companies worldwide, offering customers a single
place to search, compare, and book vehicles. It functions as an aggregator, like other
travel booking sites, by compiling offers from many different car rental agencies to help
users find suitable cars for their trips. Users can search for cars by location and dates,
compare details, and then book through the Rentcars website or app.
Why we recommend: We recommend Rentcars for its wide selection, competitive rates, and flexibility in booking short- or long-term rentals.
How it helps: Rentcars helps newcomers stay mobile and independent by providing easy access to affordable rental cars upon arrival in a new country.
Link: https://www.rentcars.com/en/?requestorid=9323&utm_source=smoothmigration.ca&utm_medium=afiliado

Country: South Africa
Partner: Wise
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Wise (formerly TransferWise) is a financial technology company that
provides online money transfer services and a multi-currency account for
individuals and businesses to send, spend, and receive money
internationally at low fees and the mid-market exchange rate. Key features
include high-speed, low-fee international transfers, a debit card for
spending in different currencies, and the ability to hold balances in over 40
currencies.
Why we recommend: We recommend Wise for its transparency, speed, and cost-effectiveness compared to traditional banks.
How it helps: Wise helps newcomers move money internationally with ease, making it simpler to manage expenses and support family abroad during relocation.
Link: https://wise.prf.hn/click/camref:1011lq4nL

Country: South Africa
Partner: Remitly
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Remitly is a digital remittance service that enables users to send money internationally
quickly, affordably, and securely, primarily, to family and friends. To use it, you create an
account on the Remitly website or mobile app, enter the recipient's details and desired
amount, select a delivery option like bank deposit, cash pickup, or mobile money, and
pay for the transfer. Remitly guarantees on-time delivery or refunds your fees and uses
multiple security layers to protect transfers.
Why we recommend: We recommend Remitly for its fast transfers, multiple payout options, and reliable customer support.
How it helps: Remitly helps newcomers easily send money to family or manage finances across borders, reducing stress during relocation.
Link: https://remitly.tod8mp.net/Jr6DAv

Country: South Africa
Partner: XE
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Xe (xe.com) is a company that provides online currency conversion tools and
international money transfer services. You can use their website and app to convert
currencies at market rates, view historical charts and set rate alerts, and send money
directly to bank accounts or for cash pickup in other countries. To send money, you
register for an account, provide details of the recipient, confirm the payment amount,
choose a payment method (like a bank transfer or card), and process the transaction.
Why we recommend: We recommend XE for its reliability, transparent fees, and real-time currency tracking.
How it helps: XE helps newcomers manage cross-border finances efficiently, making it easier to pay bills, receive funds, or transfer money internationally.
Link: https://xe-money-transfer.sjv.io/9WNvNe

Country: South Africa
Partner: Sirelo (Experts in Moving)
Category: International Moving
Overview: Sirelo (Experts in Moving) is an independent online platform for the moving industry that helps people find
and compare removal companies by providing customer reviews and free quotes for
international and national moves. Users can post their experiences with moving
companies to create a comprehensive database of reviews and can request up to five
free quotes from movers in their area. Sirelo's goal is to make the moving process more
transparent for consumers.
Why we recommend: We recommend Experts in Moving for their experience, reliable service, and personalized approach to international relocations.
How it helps: Experts in Moving helps newcomers transport their belongings safely and efficiently, reducing stress during the moving process.
Link: https://www.expertsinmoving.com/?so=a&ca=8ddabfceef8192200632f66a00293f9c
